title: One world, one opinion? The superstar effect in LLM responses
reasoning: The paper focuses on the 'superstar effect' and cultural homogenization in LLM responses across different languages and professions. While it observes that religious figures like Jesus Christ or Buddha are frequently returned in the 'Person' category, the study does not evaluate or benchmark religious doctrines, faith-based epistemologies, or ethical reasoning frameworks as its core objective.
